bias.zh: 回调加深 · 跌破 30 日均线，测试 $203

read.en: Zscaler fell 9.2% on Nov 5 to $203.88, trading between $203.02 and $216.43. It is below the falling 5-day ($223.0) and the rising 10-day ($239.4) and 30-day ($221.9) averages, and above the rising 100-day ($180.6) and 200-day ($167.1). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2, still above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($263.30), and RSI is 40.
read.zh: Zscaler 11月5日下跌 9.2%，收于 $203.88，盘中区间 $203.02–216.43。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$223.0）以及上行的 10 日（$239.4）和 30 日均线（$221.9）下方，仍高于上行的 100 日（$180.6）和 200 日均线（$167.1）。MACD 自 11月2日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴上方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$263.30），RSI 为 40。

read.en: The drop broke the $220.1–222.3 support (30-day, Oct 14 and Nov 3–4 lows) and $214.5, both now resistance, and the $203.02 low dipped under the Oct 16 low ($203.33) before the close held just above it. Resistance is $214.5–216.4, then $220.1–223 (30 and 5-day) and $229.2–231.6. Support is $203–203.3, then $195.1 (Sep 29 and Oct 2 lows) and $187.7. A close above $216.4 would target $220–223; below $203, $195.
